title: startFeaturePlan
responsibility: Start an approved feature's queue-only retry or a bounded approval-scoped worker batch.

inputs.name: startFeaturePlan.feature
inputs.description: Feature identifier passed to the exact approved-plan selector.

inputs.name: startFeaturePlan.options
inputs.type: { digest: string; worker?: string; parallelism?: string; json?: boolean }
inputs.description: The expected approval digest; optional worker enables a single batch with integer concurrency 1 through 8, defaulting to one.

inputs.name: startFeaturePlan.server
inputs.description: Trusted server; dispatch requires its approval-scoped runApproved operation.

inputs.name: startFeaturePlan.output
inputs.description: Receives the successful JSON or human-readable submission and worker outcomes.

outputs.name: startFeaturePlan
outputs.description: Without a worker, await and print idempotent approved submission. With a worker, await and print the actual bounded approved batch; remove only this command's signal listeners when settled.

errors.name: invalid dispatch configuration
errors.description: Reject parallelism without a worker, a non-integer or out-of-range value, or missing approval-scoped dispatch before executing a worker.

errors.name: server or output failure
errors.description: Propagate without claiming a successful start; the server retains its approval, readiness and isolation checks.
